inputMode: CN setup -> EN paused -> CN verification
setup: Preview only. Each case independently starts CN/Clear, digits123, Home then ArrowRight, N08. Switch language to EN without confirming; paused n must survive. Test one of seven top editor controls; guard must preserve raw/document/caret/selection-off. Cancel in EN, return CN, digit9 must produce 1923. Do not select candidates, Space or Enter.
Clear while CN; digits 123; selection OFF; modifiers unlit
Home then ArrowRight: caret between 1 and 2
N08: raw n; tap language button once to EN
verify EN and paused raw n retained
verification: tap Cancel while still EN; paused n disappears, confirmed text remains
tap language button back to CN
tap main digit 9
cases.actual: 按EN暂停组合保护及返回CN后1923验证步骤反馈正常，未逐项转录
